package clickhouse

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2/lib/driver"
	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
)

type BatchConn interface {
	PrepareBatch(ctx context.Context, query string) (BatchWriter, error)
}

type BatchWriter interface {
	Append(values ...any) error
	Send() error
}

type EventRepository struct {
	conn  BatchConn
	table string
}

func NewEventRepository(conn clickhouse.Conn) *EventRepository {
	return &EventRepository{conn: &connWrapper{conn: conn}, table: "stat_events"}
}

// NewEventRepositoryWithConn allows injecting a custom batch connection (used in tests).
func NewEventRepositoryWithConn(conn BatchConn, table string) *EventRepository {
	return &EventRepository{conn: conn, table: table}
}

func (r *EventRepository) InsertBatch(ctx context.Context, events []domain.Event) error {
	if len(events) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	batch, err := r.conn.PrepareBatch(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (event_ts, user_id, role, session_id, course_id, course_version_id, lesson_id, task_id, platform, editor_mode, client_ts, event_type, payload) VALUES", r.table))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, ev := range events {
		if err := batch.Append(
			ev.EventTS,
			ev.UserID,
			ev.Role,
			ev.SessionID,
			ev.CourseID,
			uuid.Nil,
			ev.LessonID,
			ev.TaskID,
			ev.Platform,
			ev.EditorMode,
			ev.ClientTS,
			ev.EventType,
			string(ev.Payload),
		); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return batch.Send()
}

type connWrapper struct {
	conn driver.Conn
}

func (c *connWrapper) PrepareBatch(ctx context.Context, query string) (BatchWriter, error) {
	batch, err := c.conn.PrepareBatch(ctx, query)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &batchWrapper{batch: batch}, nil
}

type batchWrapper struct {
	batch driver.Batch
}

func (b *batchWrapper) Append(values ...any) error {
	return b.batch.Append(values...)
}

func (b *batchWrapper) Send() error {
	return b.batch.Send()
}
